curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Crayon on rough paper, low and casual. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre earns its keep big and brief, while Tsukimi Rounded, with round forms like open parentheses, wouldn't carry pages of dense text.
curated-gf-kapakana-gf-spectral-sc: Loose handwriting over a bookish serif. Kapakana is best for a few lines, where its letter pairs almost merge, while Spectral SC's sturdy hairlines and wide mouths do the steadier work.
